args.body:
## Summary
Add validation to prevent login page crash when password is empty and add unit test.

## Changes
- Modified `src/auth.js`: Add check to return false when password is empty
- Modified `test/auth.test.js`: Add unit test for empty password scenario

## Testing
All tests pass (5/5).
